title: "trim"

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = ">"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(saferTool2)
```
<br>

### Datasets

```{r}
data <- 1:10
```
<br>

### Datasets info

```{r}
data
```
<br>
